title: Hammer with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='46' rx='4' fill='#d9a05b'/>
  <rect x='48' y='42' width='4' height='46' fill='#f0c48a'/>
  <!-- handle grip end -->
  <rect x='42' y='83' width='16' height='7' rx='3' fill='#b06d2e'/>
  <!-- hammer head -->
  <rect x='24' y='16' width='52' height='28' rx='7' fill='#c0c8d8'/>
  <!-- hammer head top highlight -->
  <rect x='28' y='19' width='44' height='8' rx='4' fill='#e6ecf5'/>
  <!-- hammer head bottom shade -->
  <rect x='28' y='37' width='44' height='5' rx='2' fill='#98a4b8'/>
  <!-- face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='31' r='4' fill='#203a6b'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='31' r='4' fill='#203a6b'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='29.5' r='1.5' fill='#cfe6ff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='29.5' r='1.5' fill='#cfe6ff'/>
  <!-- face: smile -->
  <path d='M40 37 Q50 44 60 37' stroke='#203a6b' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little sparkle on head -->
  <path d='M74 22 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5z' fill='#fff4a3'/>
</svg>
